en: The waves are huge! We'll sink!
Hold on tight!
Don't be scared! I have oil.
Oil? On the sea?
Old sailors poured oil on the waves.
The waves stopped breaking!
A thin layer of oil calms the water.
Wait... that's my mother's cooking oil!

en: What is this strange jar?
A teapot, obviously!
No! It feels earthquakes!
China made it 1,900 years ago.
A ball fell into the frog!
But nobody felt anything!
Days later, news came: an earthquake far away!
Smarter than my phone!
